candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s) from inventory, causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s across all sampled correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs; whether timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or config is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; metrics confirm 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms with zero 200s. Topology places redis behind inventory. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency, saturation, and connection metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs showing Redis client timeout configuration and retry behavior
